go-jsonschema validate --schema schema.json --output verbose any.json
# Core-vocabulary /$schema annotation reports the declared dialect URI
# (spec §8.1.1). Useful for consumers detecting legacy drafts.
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/\$schema"'
stdout '"annotation":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"'

-- schema.json --
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "string"
}
-- any.json --
"hello"
